protocol.primary: equal-weight mean adapted-minus-scratch MRR across four fractions and three seeds
protocol.acceptance: relative aggregate MRR gain >= 10% versus scratch ULTRA AND both KGE controls; all four fractions positive versus scratch; adapted/scratch/kgeTimed durations within 10% of 2 seconds (kge50 excluded)
protocol.training: support-only strict negatives; remove batch positive edges and inverse edges before rebuilding relation graph; BCE equal positive/negative group weights
protocol.selection: nested hash sample with one support fact per relation floor
protocol.querySelection: fixed prior 64 SHA-selected facts on diagnostic graphs; all 24 official Countries S1 test facts for confirmation
protocol.limits: Timing checked between updates permits one-step overrun. Wall time is not equal compute. No production promotion.
